title: looking for more rpg maker mz statues. I need a dwarf statue mostly

posts.body: Ive found several post for statues and a few i liked and a few i didnt need. however i havent found a single dwarf statue. which i feel is weird but i could just not be looking in the right areas. if anyone knows of more statues and or a dwarf statue that ive been searching for please let me know. kinda hard to make a dwarven fortress without dwarfs. i would even take like statues that are in grave to a wall. or something. just been having a hard time finding some. thank you in advance!
